scenario: A marketplace operations team reviews a new seller's onboarding submission: their product listing CSV is processed to compute per-listing quality scores, product description texts are analyzed for authenticity and AI-generation signals, and the results are synthesized into a seller onboarding approval report that determines whether the seller passes the quality gate.
info_flow: csv-pipeline reads the seller's product listing CSV and computes a completeness/quality score for each listing → nlp-toolkit analyzes each product description text for AI-generation indicators (perplexity, burstiness, entropy) and assigns an authenticity label → reporting combines both score streams into a seller onboarding approval report with an overall recommendation.
